opportunity.title: IBM Mainframes and Maintenance for the FDIC
opportunity.description: The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation requests quotes under RFQ CORHQ-26-Q-0388 for new IBM mainframes and maintenance. Offerors must complete the price schedule. Terms and conditions, EULA or MSAs must accompany the quote; FDIC prefers government-approved terms. Quotes need a letter of authorization from the manufacturer and, if applicable, a proposed GSA Schedule or NASA SEWP contract. Questions were due Oct 9, 2026; quotes are due Oct 22, 2026. IBM site numbers for FDIC are 5166681 (VASQ) and 4742836 (DFW/BDC).

supportedClaims.text: The FDIC is soliciting quotes for new IBM mainframes and maintenance services at its Arlington, Virginia location.
Offerors must submit a price schedule and include terms and conditions, EULA, or MSAs with their quote.
Every contractor awarded an FDIC contract must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM).
The contracting office contact for this solicitation is ditoles@fdic.gov, phone 5712134018.

rationale.point: The solicitation is for IBM mainframes and maintenance services at Arlington, VA (claim 1), but the company's past performance consists solely of web and data platform projects for state/local agencies under $500K with no mainframe hardware or maintenance experience.
The company has no prior VA, DoD, or HHS prime contracts and lacks facility clearance or a SOC 2 report, which are likely necessary for on-site federal mainframe work described in claim 1.

While administrative requirements such as submitting a price schedule, terms, EULA/MSAs (claim 2) and SAM registration (claim 3) are manageable, they do not mitigate the fundamental technical mismatch.

risks: No relevant past performance for IBM mainframe hardware procurement and maintenance
No federal prime contract experience, particularly with FDIC or similar financial regulators
Small team of six engineers unlikely to possess specialized mainframe expertise
Absence of facility clearance and SOC 2 report for on-site work at a federal facility
nextSteps: Assess ability to compile required price schedule and legal terms (claim 2)
Determine if any teaming arrangement could bridge the technical gap (internal assessment only)
